about.title: About SalonGo
about.lead: SalonGo builds software for nail, hair, lash and beauty studios in Europe, starting with Vietnamese-run salons in Czechia.
about.why1: Many salons still write bookings in a notebook, work out wages by hand and only see their profit at the end of the month.
about.why2: Most salon software has no Vietnamese and doesn't fit how these salons are run.
about.why3: From 2027 every salon in Czechia has to report receipts to EET 2.0.
about.promise1: Data is stored in Frankfurt (Germany), inside the EU, under GDPR.
about.promise2: When a plan ends, your data stays.
about.promise3: Support in Czech and Vietnamese, replies within 24 hours.
about.promise4: Prices and what each plan includes are on the website.
about.doTitle: What SalonGo does for your salon
about.do1: Clients book through a link; staff see the day on their phone.
about.do2: Fast checkout, printed or e-mailed receipts, QR bank transfer.
about.do3: Every receipt goes to the tax office automatically, in every plan.
about.do4: Pay by revenue or percentage, worked out at the end of the period.
about.do5: See your monthly profit without a notebook.
about.fact5: The app speaks 6 languages: Vietnamese, Czech, Slovak, English, German, French.
about.fact6: Works in the browser (phone, iPad) and on Mac and Windows.
about.contactLead: Call, message or e-mail us. We reply within 24 hours.
about.do6: One-time checkout software installed on the salon's computer.
about.do7: SalonGo Web Studio builds your own website, 35+ designs.
